summary:
This repository is a React + Vite account-signup demo (`src/pages/Signup.jsx`, `Login.jsx`, `Welcome.jsx`, shared styles in `src/style.css`). There is no Angular, no `AppModule`/NgModule, no Bootstrap 4, no navbar, and no tutorials entity — so items 1–3 describe an application that does not exist here, and I did not invent one. I took the smaller reading: apply item 4's visual polish to the app this repo actually has.

Changed:
- `index.html` — linked the Inter Google font with preconnects (this project's entry HTML is at the repo root; there is no `src/index.html`).
- `src/style.css` (this repo's shared stylesheet; there is no `src/styles.css`) — light grey page background, Inter as the base family, one consistent indigo→purple colour scheme, rounded cards with a soft shadow that lifts on hover, rounded inputs with an indigo focus glow, gradient buttons, and smooth hover transitions throughout. Spacing tightened into a consistent rhythm.

No component logic, services, routes or markup were touched, and there are no existing component tests in this repo to update. Project password rules were not touched — this change adds no password field and the existing ones are unchanged.
blockers: Not applied -- 1. HeaderComponent in src/app/components/header/ declared in AppModule, gradient navbar, footer: This repo is React + Vite with no Angular, no AppModule and no navbar; the described app does not exist here
Not applied -- 2. Tutorials list card grid, search bar, empty state, Remove All button: There is no tutorials entity or list page in this repository
Not applied -- 3. Add/Edit pages with Bootstrap alerts: There are no Add/Edit tutorial pages and Bootstrap is not a dependency here
Not applied -- Keep Bootstrap 4 and NgModule; update existing component tests: Neither Bootstrap nor NgModule is used in this repo, and it contains no component tests

Visual verification failed: The signup page at /signup does show item 4's polish — Inter font, light grey background, rounded white card with soft shadow, rounded inputs and an indigo-to-purple gradient button — but none of items 1-3 are visible: there is no gradient navbar/header with 'Tutorial Manager' logo or Tutorials/Add Tutorial links, no footer, and no tutorials card grid with search bar, status pills or empty state (this React/Vite repo has only Signup/Login/Welcome pages). The restyled Password field also shows no five password rules beneath it, which this project's recorded rule requires wherever a password is chosen.

context_sharing.notes: Neither changed file contains any API contract: index.html is a Vite shell mounting /src/main.jsx into #root, and src/style.css is pure presentation (CSS custom properties and styles for .card, .field, .message.error/.message.ok, .switch). Any endpoint definitions live elsewhere in src/, not in these files.
